findings.issue: Docstring overclaims: it calls the result "the plus-ring half of Wedhorn's Theorem 7.35" and pivots to "its pro-constructibility in `Spv (A, IA)`", but the theorem proves pro-constructibility in `Spv A`. Pro-constructibility only restricts along a spectral map (`IsProConstructible.preimage`, ProConstructible.lean:198), and the inclusion `Spv(A,I) → Spv A` is documented as non-spectral (ProConstructible.lean:24-26, SpvOfIdeal/Spectral.lean:47-50); this file's own overview says such statements "do not transfer to the traces along the inclusion" (line 25-29). Same overclaim in the Main-results bullet at lines 47-49.

findings.issue: The module overview enumerates what lives in the file (patch presentation, then quasi-compactness of the generating family) and explicitly delimits it ("It says nothing about Lemma 7.5(1) ... these statements do not transfer to the traces along the inclusion"). The new pro-constructibility section is absent from that prose, so the overview both under-describes the file and reads as contradicting the new bullet.

summary: The new theorem and its Main-results bullet are documented, but both bill an `Spv A`-level statement as "the plus-ring half" of Wedhorn 7.35, whose pro-constructibility is needed in `Spv (A, IA)` — a transfer the same file and `ProConstructible.lean` explicitly say does not happen. The module overview was also left un-updated for the new section.
